welcome-sub: Ɔkwan a ɛbɛma Africa anya ahoɔden denam Pi Ecosystem so
africa-day: (Wɔ Afrika Da a ɛtɔ so 25 mu, wɔayi Pi Pioneers Ntetee Application yi adi)
memorial-title: 🕊️ Wɔ Ɔdɔ Nkae mu ma Christina Muzheki Manjengwa
memorial-text:
Wɔde Nhomasua Hub yi ama me nuabea panyin a medɔ no Christina Muzheki Manjengwa a ɔhomee wɔ 8 Ɔbɛnem 2026 na wɔde no too da wɔ 11 Ɔbɛnem a ɛyɛ Zimbabwe Heroes Ahomegye Da.
Wo dɔ, wo akwankyerɛ ne w’ahoɔden kɔ so hyɛ yɛn botae sɛ yɛbɛma Africa anya ahoɔden mu den.
Daa wɔ yɛn akoma mu. Home wɔ ahoɔden mu, Nuabea.
intro-p1: Pi Network yɛ sika a wɔde di dwuma wɔ dijitaal mu ne wiase nyinaa ecosystem dwumadie a wɔayɛ sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a cryptocurrency bɛbɔ ne mfaso ama obiara.
intro-p2: Nea ɛnte sɛ amammerɛ mu cryptocurrencies a ɛhwehwɛ sika a ne bo yɛ den a wɔde tu fagude, Pi Network ma nnipa a wɔyɛ nkɔmɔ de tumi de wɔn ho hyɛ mu tẽ fi wɔn telefon so.
intro-p3: Adɛn nti na Pi ma Africa?
intro-list:
• Si dijitaal sikasɛm a ɛka obiara ho a banke nni mu
  • Ma nnipa a wɔyɛ nkɔmɔ de ahoɔden wɔ wiase nyinaa ne telefon tu
  • Ma nokware dwumadie nkɔso denam utilities ne DApps so
  • Boa nnipa ne nnipa aguadi na tew ka ho
  • Stanford PhDs na wɔyɛe - Dr Nicolas Kokkalis & Dr Chengdiao Fan
  • Boro Miliyɔn 60 Pioneers wɔ wiase
ch1-p1: Anammɔn 1: Twi Pi Network - Fa link yi di dwuma: minepi.com/chigalex1
ch1-p2: Anammɔn 2: Kyerɛw wo din wɔ Facebook anaa Telefon so → Hyɛ koodu no mu: CHIGALEX1 → Nya 1 Pi abasobɔde
ch1-p3: Da biara Mining: San bra bɛyɛ nnɔnhwere 24 biara na mia aprannaa bɔtn no so na woakɔ so atu fagude.
ch1-p4: Mfomso a Ɛtaa ba a Ɛsɛ sɛ Wokwati:
ch1-list2:
• Mfa din atorɔ nni dwuma - ɛsɛ sɛ ɛne ID hyia ma KYC
  • Mmɔ account pii - onipa baako account baako
  • Fa alarm si hɔ ma mining daa nnɔnhwere 24 biara na woakora rate no
  • Kɔ security circle mu wɔ nna 3 akyi na nnipa 5 a wogye wodi
ch1-list:
• Bɔ Pi wallet wɔ ahobammɔ mu
  • Wie 2FA
  • Wie KYC
  • Siesie wo ho ma Mainnet tu ho
security-msg: ⚠️ Wallet ahobammɔ: MPAE wo 24 passphrase nsɛm no mu da! Pi Core Kuw no RENNE bisa wo da!
ch2-p1: Wo Pi Wallet yɛ wo sikakorabea wɔ Pi Ecosystem mu. Ɛkura wo Pi sika no wɔ ahobammɔ mu wɔ blockchain so.
ch2-p2: Ɔkwan a wɔfa so bɔ: Bue Pi Browser → Wallet → Bɔ Wallet → KOPIA wo nsɛm 24 no → Sie offline wɔ mmeae 2 a ahobammɔ wɔ.
ch2-p3: Pi Gye: Kyɛ wo ɔmanfoɔ address (hyɛ aseɛ ne G...). Pi Soma: Fa nea ɔregye no address no hyɛ mu, hyɛ dodoɔ no mu, si so dua.
ch2-list:
• Kyerɛw passphrase wɔ krataa so, ɛnyɛ screenshot
  • Sie wɔ mmeae 2 a ahobammɔ wɔ a ɛsono emu (ɛnyɛ telefon nko)
  • Sɔ hwɛ ne 1 Pi ansa na woasoma dodow kɛse
  • Hwɛ address no mu nkyerɛwde 4 a edi kan ne 4 a etwa to no daa
ch2a-p1: Mfaso: Hyɛ aseɛ ne sika ketewaa bi a wɔde sɔ hwɛ (1 Pi). Hwɛ sɛ address no mu nkyerɛwde 4 a edi kan ne 4 a etwa to no hyia. Mfa wo passphrase no mfa nguae wɛbsaet biara so!
ch2a-p2: Nokware Dwumadie: Wɔ saa ntetee yi mu, yɛbɛyɛ live demo a yɛde 1 Pi bɛsoma akɔma pioneer foforo de bɛkyekye ahotoso. Kae: Blockchain nkitahodi ntumi nsakra!
ch3-p1: Pi Browser te sɛ Google Play Store ma Pi. DApps yɛ application ahorow a wɔahwete ama nokware dwumadie — aguadi, nhomasua, agorudi, ɔsom dwumadie nyinaa de Pi di dwuma.
ch3-list:
• Pi Chain Mall (PCM) - Aguadibea kɛse ma Pi
  • WorkforcePool - Adwuma ma Pioneers
  • CareForPi - Akwahosan mu mmoa
  • Chigalex1 Hub - Nhomasua (App yi)
  • Na 100+ dwumadie foforo
ch4-p1: Hwehwɛ nnwuma a egye Pi wɔ wiase nyinaa wɔ mapofpi.com. Kyerɛw w’adwumayɛ ankasa na fi aseɛ gye Pi ma nneɛma ne ɔsom.
ch4-p2: Ɔkwan a Wobɛfa so Akyerɛw W’adwumayɛ: Kɔ mapofpi.com → Fa Pi Wallet bɔ mu → Fa Adwumayɛ ka ho → Fa mfonini, beae, nneɛma ka ho → Nneɛmafo bɛhu wo! Ɛyi ne ɔkwan a Africa bɛdi anim wɔ Pi gye mu.
ch5-p1: Wiase Nyinaa Nkabom Bo (GCV) hyɛ nokware dwumadie ho nkuran. 1 Pi = $314,159 GCV. Saa bo yi na pioneers a wɔde Pi di dwuma wɔ nokware aguadi mu na ɛkyekye.
ch5-p2: GCV Nkyerɛase: GCV nyɛ exchange bo. Ɛyɛ kuo a wɔde bɔ Pi bo ho ban denam Pi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ consensus kɛse mu wɔ yɛn ankasa aguadi mu. Sɛ yɛde Pi di dwuma ma nokware nneɛma wɔ GCV mu a, yɛbɔ hia ne dwumadie. Eyi yɛ sikasɛm mu ahoɔden ma Africa.
ch6-p1: Sua Doris Yin manual ma mfaso yɛ ne ecosystem nyin. Yɛ nhwehwɛmu, sua, na kyerɛ afoforo — eyi ne ɔkwan a yɛde hyɛ Afrika den.
ch6-p2: Wo Dwuma sɛ Africa Pioneer: Sua → Yɛ → Kyerɛkyerɛ nnipa 2 → Saa 2 no kyerɛkyerɛ 2 foforo. Eyi ne ɔkwan a yɛde du 1 Miliyɔn Afrikafo a wɔakyerɛw wɔn! Twi Whitepaper, kenkan, na kyɛ nimdeɛ da biara.
final-msg: Africa wɔ hokwan sɛ ɛbɛyɛ ɔmantam a ɛyɛ den paa wɔ mfaso dwumadie mu wɔ Pi Ecosystem mu. Yɛn nyinaa Si. Yɛn nyinaa Kyerɛkyerɛ.
